import datetime, hashlib, json, resource, runpy, sys, time
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

project = Path.cwd()
test = runpy.run_path(str(project / 'tests/test_moneyflow_history_promote.py'))
engine, promote, Source = test['engine'], test['promote'], test['Source']
engine.shutil.disk_usage = lambda _: SimpleNamespace(free=128 * 1024**3)
mode = sys.argv[1]
root = Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-promotion-20261008') / (mode + '-validated-v3')
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows, fixtures = {}, {}
for ds in test['DATASETS']:
    path = project / 'tests/fixtures' / (ds + '_20260930.json')
    if path.exists():
        items = json.loads(path.read_text(), parse_float=Decimal)
        fixtures[ds] = {'path': str(path.relative_to(project)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'rows': len(items)}
        fields = [c.name for c in test['history_schema'](ds)]
        rows[ds] = [{**{f: item.get(f) for f in fields}, 'trade_date': '2026-09-30'} for item in items]
    else:
        item = Source.row(ds)
        item['net_amount'] = '-123456.7890'
        rows[ds] = [item]
        fixtures[ds] = {'kind': 'synthetic_negative_and_null', 'rows': 1}
if mode == 'max_batch':
    original = rows['moneyflow'][:5000]
    rows['moneyflow'] = [{**row, 'trade_date': (datetime.date(2026,9,1)+datetime.timedelta(days=offset)).isoformat()} for offset in range(20) for row in original]
    fixtures['moneyflow']['expansion'] = '5000 distinct existing fixture codes across 20 synthetic dates; 100000 rows'
start = time.monotonic()
staging, lake, source = test['setup'](root, rows)
built = time.monotonic()-start
operation = test['operation'](staging)
expected = {}
checkpoints = {}
for checkpoint in operation.rglob('checkpoint.json'):
    receipt = json.loads(checkpoint.read_text())
    checkpoints[str(checkpoint.relative_to(operation))] = hashlib.sha256(checkpoint.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for fact in receipt['files']:
        for layer in ('raw','silver'):
            target = (promote.raw_moneyflow_path if layer == 'raw' else promote.silver_moneyflow_path)(lake, checkpoint.relative_to(operation).parts[0], fact['trade_date'])
            expected[str(target.relative_to(lake))] = fact[layer+'_sha256']
start=time.monotonic(); preflight=test['run'](staging,lake); planned=time.monotonic()-start
assert not test['hashes'](lake)
start=time.monotonic(); applied=test['run'](staging,lake,apply=True); applying=time.monotonic()-start
assert test['hashes'](lake)==expected
assert all(hashlib.sha256((operation / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest for p,digest in checkpoints.items())
assert applied['promoted_rows']==sum(len(r) for r in rows.values())
assert not list(operation.rglob('*.parquet'))
start=time.monotonic(); replay=test['run'](staging,lake,apply=True); replaying=time.monotonic()-start
assert test['hashes'](lake)==expected
assert source.calls==applied['copy_transactions']==replay['copy_transactions']==28
manifest=json.loads((operation/'cohort.json').read_text())
result={'mode':mode,'kind':'isolated fixtures; no actual source network or formal Lake', 'fixture_sources':fixtures,'plans':manifest['plans'],'total_rows':manifest['total_rows'],'total_dates':manifest['total_dates'],'total_units':manifest['total_units'],'total_files':len(expected),'source_requests_fake':source.calls,'promotion_source_requests':0,'seconds':{'candidates':built,'preflight':planned,'apply':applying,'replay':replaying},'peak_rss_mib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/(1024**2),'formal_parquet_bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in lake.rglob('*.parquet')),'staging_bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in operation.rglob('*') if p.is_file()),'shared_retained_bytes':replay['retained_bytes'],'row_differences':0,'rejects':0,'sha256_files':expected,'candidate_checkpoints_sha256':checkpoints,'apply_progress':applied,'replay_progress':replay}
(root/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ('mode','total_rows','total_dates','total_units','total_files','seconds','peak_rss_mib','formal_parquet_bytes','shared_retained_bytes')}))
